{{Quote|Sixteen years those rail-thin, self-righteous Ayrou kept me locked up in that stinking, rotten-fish-infested hole.|A Thonnerman|<ref name="Tessent" />}}
'''Thonner''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]]. It was covered in shallow [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and [[Water/Legends|seas]] that were broken by strings of sandy islands. Freshwater vents also dotted Thonner's surface, and [[Maya Kovel lichen|lichen]] imported from the planet [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]] grew on the world's islands. Thonner's [[Lesser Firagh Peninsula]] was home to dangerous fauna such as the [[Zoun mauler]].

[[Colonist/Legends|Settled]] in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], Thonner hosted a native population of [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], and [[Kian'thar]] who were collectively known as [[Thonnermen]]. Practicing [[Fisher/Legends|fishing]] and [[Trapper/Legends|trapping]] as well as [[Lichen/Legends|lichen]] [[Farmer/Legends|farming]], they led a semi-nomadic existence. Initially the Ayrou used Thonner as a [[Prison/Legends|penal]] colony, and the [[Prisoner/Legends|incarcerated]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Vcikas]] hid on the planet a statue that was valued by the Ayrou. At some point, the Ayrou presence on Thonner decreased to just a few individuals, and the [[t'landa Til]] [[Korraj]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] gang of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] maintained a [[Korraj's base|base]] on the planet.

==Description==
{{Quote|That mauler came down on us outta nowhere. Cut me nearly in two, and you can see what he done to my face.|A Thonnerman, on their and Vcikas' trek across the Lesser Firagh Peninsula|<ref name="Tessent" />}}
Thonner was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that occupied the fourth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position<ref name="Endor" /> in the [[Thonner system/Legends|Thonner system]]. It lay within the [[Inner Moddell systems]] area of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]],<ref name="EAOC Thonner" /> one of the [[Sector/Legends|subsectors]] making up the [[Inner Zuma Region]]<ref name="TEA" /> within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Zuma sector/Legends|Zuma sector]].<ref name="EAOC Thonner" /> Along with the rest of the Thonner [[Star system/Legends|system]], the planet was connected to the [[Maya Kovel system/Legends|Maya Kovel]] and [[Ovise system/Legends|Ovise systems]] by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Annaj-Houche Run]], while another [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route linked it to the [[Qina system/Legends|Qina system]].<ref name="TEA" />

Thonner's [[local year]] lasted 312 [[Local day/Legends|local days]], each of which was twenty-one [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] long. Its [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] was ninety-five percent standard, and it had a breathable Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] climate. The planet was covered in shallow [[Salt/Legends|saltwater]] [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] and [[Water/Legends|seas]] that were broken by chains of sandy islands. Bubbling freshwater vents also dotted Thonner's surface,<ref name="Endor" /> while [[Swamp/Legends|marshlands]] in which [[corsit-puzzle tree]]s grew covered the [[Lesser Firagh Peninsula]] of the [[Firagh]] continent.<ref name="Tessent" /> In addition, by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], lush colonies of [[Maya Kovel lichen|lichen]] imported from the planet [[Maya Kovel/Legends|Maya Kovel]] covered many of Thonner's islands.<ref name="Endor" />

The wildlife of Thonner included [[Fish/Legends|fish]] as well as [[Thonnerwrot]]s, a type of [[Bone/Legends|bony]] marine [[Crustacean/Legends|crustaceans]].<ref name="Endor" /> The fauna of the Lesser Firagh Peninsula, which included the [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-climbing [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibian]] [[corsit]] and the fierce [[Diet/Legends|predator]] known as the [[Zoun mauler]], was dangerous enough that the planet's [[Thonnermen]] inhabitants did not establish any settlements in the area.<ref name="Tessent" />

==History==
===Ayrou prison world===
Despite Thonner's location on the relatively well-traveled Annaj-Houche Run, the planet was only [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] in [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]],<ref name="Endor" /> although by that time it had already served for [[Standard year/Legends|years]] as a hideout for occasional fugitives. Members of the [[Ayrou/Legends|Ayrou]] [[Species/Legends|species]] helped develop the first settlements on Thonner, and they had a heavy presence on the world in the years following settlement.<ref name="Tessent" />

The Ayrou used Thonner as a [[Prison/Legends|penal]] colony for those Ayrou and other [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] who had resorted to using violence in order to achieve their goals, which was anathema in the Ayrou society. Eventually, however, only a few Ayrou remained on Thonner, the species denied having used the planet as a prison, and the former Ayrou presence on the world came to be chiefly represented by the [[Lichen/Legends|lichen]]<ref name="Tessent" /> imported from the Ayrou [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Maya Kovel.<ref name="Endor" />

===Dangerous escape===
{{RPG|"[[Race for the Tessent]]"}}
{{Quote|<nowiki />''[&hellip; Vcika's]'' prolly got that funny lookin' little statue with him, too. Loved that thing more than life itself&hellip; said when he got outta the joint he'd go dig it up from where he'd stashed it out past the mollusk arches and that the Ayrou 'would never get it back,' whatever that meant.|A Thonnerman|<ref name="Tessent" />}}
[[File:Ayrou_SWG9.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Ayrou (an Ayrou pictured) used Thonner as a penal colony.]]
Sometime during the use of Thonner as an Ayrou prison, sly incarcerated Ayrou criminals stashed on the planet a statue sought after by their species. The [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] planned to escape and retrieve the statue, but it eventually fell into the hands of another incarcerated individual, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Vcikas]], who became very attached to the artifact and buried it at a site past the [[mollusk arches]], determined&mdash;similarly to its previous owners&mdash;to retrieve it once [[Gender/Legends|he]] left prison.<ref name="Tessent" />

At some point at least sixteen years after the settlement of Thonner, a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] became active at a location south of the Ayrou holding cells, and when it began to cause trouble for the prison [[Security guard/Legends|guards]], a group of prisoners including Vcikas overwhelmed their sentries and escaped into the Lesser Firagh Peninsula. There, the dangerous fauna [[Death/Legends|claimed]] the lives of every escapee except the Mon Calamari and an [[Unidentified Thonnerman|individual]] whom the Ayrou had imprisoned for participating in a fistfight on Maya Kovel. By the time the pair had reached the sea, they had suffered an attack by a Zoun mauler that left the face of Vcikas' companion disfigured.<ref name="Tessent" />

===A hidden statue===
{{Quote|Figure ''[Vcikas]'' must still be out there, livin' off the land and taking some of our harvest during the leaner seasons.|A Thonnerman|<ref name="Tessent" />}}
The Mon Calamari became separated from his companion, and the latter was found by Thonnermen who adopted the former prisoner as a worker. When the Ayrou guards visited the Thonnermen in search of the escapees, they did not recognize Vcikas' former fellow inmate due to their scars. The worker believed that Vcikas came to live off the land on Thonner, taking some of the Thonnermen's harvest during lean seasons.<ref name="Tessent" />

At some point, the former prisoner of the Ayrou relayed the story of their escape to a listener, and eventually Thonner was visited by a group of [[Treasure hunting/Legends|treasure hunters]] who, on the account of the tale, believed that the statue Vcikas had possessed was, in fact, one of the two [[Alsakan Tessent|valuable]] [[Ayrou Tessent|artifacts]] known as the [[Tessent]]s. During the visit on Thonner, the group also enlisted the help of the local [[Miner/Legends|miner]] and [[metallurgist]] [[Saqc'or]], and the local [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang led by [[Korraj]] also became involved in the search for the Tessents.<ref name="Tessent" />
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
{{Main|Thonnermen}}
{{Quote|The Thonnermen found me and kept me on with their harvesters; they didn't care where I was from, just that I worked hard and kept in line.|A Thonnerman|<ref name="Tessent" />}}
The inhabitants of Thonner were known as Thonnermen.<ref name="Tessent" /> They included thirty million [[Human/Legends|Humans]]<ref name="Endor" /> as well as members of the [[Kian'thar]] species and a few Ayrou. The semi-nomadic Thonnermen,<ref name="Tessent" /> governed by tribal councils, practiced [[Fisher/Legends|fishing]], [[Trapper/Legends|trapping]],<ref name="Endor" /> and lichen [[Farmer/Legends|farming]].<ref name="Tessent" /> They had access to [[Realspace/Legends|space]]-[[Technology level|level]] technology and exported [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuffs]] off-world in exchange for importing [[Wood/Legends|lumber]] and technology. Ayrou [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] traveling along the Annaj-Houche Run also [[Transport/Legends|transported]] boxes of lichen [[Seed/Legends|seeds]] to Thonner.<ref name="Endor" />

The [[Svivreni]] miner and metallurgist Saqc'or resided on Thonner while [[Prospector/Legends|prospecting]] for potentially valuable untapped resources. In addition, a pirate gang led by the [[t'landa Til]] Korraj operated out of Thonner, with the group including members of several aquatic species such as [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]].<ref name="Tessent" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|We overwhelmed our sentries, and headed out into the Peninsula. Oh, that was a mistake.|A Thonnerman on their escape from an Ayrou prison|<ref name="Tessent" />}}
The Firagh continent of Thonner was at one point the site of Ayrou prisoner holding cells that were situated near the Lesser Firagh Peninsula. The pirate Korraj and his gang maintained a [[Korraj's base|base]] on the peninsula, which was in turn located between Firagh and the [[Greater Zoun Archipelago]]. The base was situated in the peninsula's shallow tidal flats, and it was only accessible via a series of treacherous sea [[Cave/Legends|caves]].<ref name="Tessent" />

The first settlements on Thonner consisted of large platforms built out of giant [[Trindellan oak]]s&mdash;imported from the [[Trindello system/Legends|Trindello system]]&mdash;above the planet's freshwater vents. Later, aqueducts were constructed in order to transport the freshwater to Thonner's islands. By the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] War, the planet also hosted a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of limited services,<ref name="Endor" /> and it was also the site of the location known as the [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusk]] arches.<ref name="Tessent" />

==Behind the scenes==
Thonner first appeared in the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure "[[Race for the Tessent]]," which was published for use with [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="Tessent" /> on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed Thonner in grid square H-16.<ref name="TEA" />

Instead of featuring a set plot, "Race for the Tessent" presents several settings in the Moddell sector, Thonner being one of them, that the player characters may visit during their search for the artifacts known as the Tessents. For each of the settings, the adventure also suggests possible circumstances for a Tessent being hidden there. Assuming that as much of the non-contradictory information presented in the adventure as possible is [[canon]]ical with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, this article assumes that the Alsakan Tessent and the Ayrou Tessent were instead hidden on the planets [[Ast Kikorie/Legends|Ast Kikorie]] and [[Vasha/Legends|Vasha]], respectively.<ref name="Tessent" />
